front.transcription:
CREATE CHECKPOINT
RULE N
Discard a City card matching your city’s affiliation to add a Checkpoint token between your city and an adjacent city.
If all 12 Checkpoint tokens have been used, take one from the board to add.

REMOVING PURSUIT TOKENS
RULE K
When an active team enters (or is built in) a city with a Pursuit token, remove the Pursuit token.
Note: Pursuit tokens are removed in this way whenever an active team enters their city (even if the team was moved by some other card or ability).
CREATE CHECKPOINT Discard a City card matching your city’s affiliation to add a Checkpoint token between your city and an adjacent city.
ENTER/EXIT INFILTRATION SITE Move between an Infiltration city and the ENTRANCE room of its Infiltration site. Your alias must match the city’s affiliation.
INFILTRATE While in a room at an Infiltration site, reveal the cards required to move to an adjacent room, then move there.
ENTER/EXIT INFILTRATION SITE Move between an Infiltration city and the ENTRANCE room of its Infiltration site. Your alias must match the city’s affiliation.
ENTER/EXIT INFILTRATION SITE Move between an Infiltration city and the ENTRANCE room of its Infiltration site. Your alias must match the city’s affiliation.
INFILTRATE While in a room at an Infiltration site, reveal the cards required to move to an adjacent room, then move there.

INFILTRATE
RULE Q
While at an Infiltration site, reveal cards from your hand matching the symbols on Security tokens for an adjacent room to move your pawn to that adjacent room. (You must cross a Security token in order to move to an adjacent room).
Whenever you enter a room, reveal all facedown Security tokens adjacent to it.
Note: While at an Infiltration site, you may do only the Infiltrate and Enter/Exit Infiltration Site actions, and are not considered to be in any city.
Security tokens are not removed during the game, but are reset at the start of each game with an Infiltration objective.

ENTER/EXIT INFILTRATION SITE
RULE P
Move your pawn between an Infiltration city and the ENTRANCE room of its Infiltration site.
You must use an alias that matches the affiliation of the Infiltration city to do this action.
Whenever you enter a room, reveal all facedown Security tokens adjacent to it.
If you exit an Infiltration site to a city with Disease cubes and/or a Contamination sticker, do not take any Symptom cards.

GET OUT!
RULE V
At the end of the Mop Up step, if your pawn is at an Infiltration site, you must shift it back to its Infiltration city.
INFILTRATE While in a room at an Infiltration site, reveal the cards required to move to an adjacent room, then move there.

INFILTRATION
"Delicate infiltration work holds the highest level of operational security; you will need to resolve these objectives personally, without the support of a team."
RIGHT NOW
1 Get Operations Cards 70 and 71; place them side-by-side next to the board to form an Infiltration site.
2 Put the 9 enclosed Security tokens by the side of the board. You’ll use them when you set up infiltration objectives. The keypad numbers on these tokens relate to the keypad numbers on the City cards.
3 Add the enclosed stickers to the rulebook and Reference cards.
